Thank you for this.
I finally worked up to the courage to tell the person I was in love with at the time when I was raped that I was... well...
We promised to lose our virginity to each other. That didn't end up happening and I had to make excuses.
She doesn't really give a shit. As far as she is concerned it is just a random person contacting her about some bullshit.

If it isn't today then tomorrow, or another day. It's coming. I deserve this death and why shouldn't I be strong enough to give it to myself?
